notes: Rewritten against the real Dify 1.17 export format. Node envelope is type: custom with the kind in data.type; kind: app; version 0.7.0; env/conversation variables keyed by name; aggregator variables are [node, key] pairs; code_language instead of language; http-request requires headers/params. Every shipped DSL is validated inside a running dify-api container against Dify's own pydantic node models.
